description:
[FREE] Verify the AgentWorld MCP + x402 payment rail are reachable and healthy
WITHOUT spending any USDC. Runs five quick checks (each with a short timeout):
  1. AgentWorld free API (economy snapshot) returns 200
  2. A paid x402 endpoint returns HTTP 402 without payment (gate alive, no spend)
  3. The x402 facilitator /supported endpoint is reachable (settlement rail)
  4. The AgentWorld public site is up (HTTP 200)
  5. The CCN news site is up (HTTP 200)
Returns an overall ok flag plus per-check status. No payment required, ever.
name: preflight_check
